title: Introduce advisory-policy pipeline and Preflight-Prober for VPC IaC CI/CD
creator: Ava Kim
description: We need a safer, more developer-friendly CI/CD flow for Terraform managing private (VPC) deployments. Current pipelines block on policy failures with little context, and we lack a low-latency pre-apply health check for VPC-specific resources (peerings, route tables, subnets). This ticket implements two complementary capabilities: 1) an "advisory policy" evaluation step that surfaces OPA/Conftest findings as inline plan annotations + a policy scorecard and only blocks applies at configurable severity thresholds; 2) a lightweight Preflight-Prober Terraform module and pipeline job that performs targeted runtime health checks and drift gating immediately before apply. The goals are to reduce noisy pipeline failures, accelerate sig-ops review cycles, and prevent high-risk applies to production VPCs.
acceptance_criteria: CI pipeline includes a new `policy-advisor` job that runs Conftest/OPA against the terraform plan and posts structured annotations on PRs with suggested fixes (regos link, example remediation snippets).
A policy score (0-100) is calculated per-plan and stored as a build artifact; repo-level policy thresholds (advisory, warn, block) can be set via repo config.

Preflight-Prober module is available in the private-deploy-iac registry and can be included in any env to run checks: BGP/peer status, route table reachability probe, subnet CIDR conflicts, and IAM role binding smoke tests.
The pipeline runs Preflight-Prober after plan and before apply; failed probes surface as actionable annotations and are tagged `preflight-failure`.
Applies are blocked only when policy score <= block_threshold OR preflight probes fail on `production` workspaces; lower severity policy violations create guidance and do not block by default.
Automated remediation suggestions are included in the policy output where possible (terraform code snippets, module parameters to change).
Integration tests (unit for rego, e2e in a staging workspace) are added and passing in CI.
technical_notes: Policy engine: Conftest running Rego bundles stored in `iac/rego-bundles`; support fast local evaluation and remote cache in CI.
Plan parsing: use `terraform show -json` to generate canonical plan JSON, pipe to conftest/opa with the policy bundle and a small policy-adapter that emits severity and remediation hints.
Policy scoring: map policy findings to weighted severities (crit=40, high=20, med=10, low=2), sum and normalize to 0-100; store metadata as `policy-score.json`.
Advisory mode: create a GitHub Checks annotation with file/line context where possible; also attach `policy-score.json` and `policy-report.html` to the CI run.

Preflight-Prober: terraform module with optional `prober` binary (Go) that runs quick TCP/ICMP probes from a worker in the target region using temporary credentials created by the pipeline. Keep runtime < 30s for common checks.

Drift gating: run a `drift-gate` job that compares live API state (via provider read) against the plan; small deltas produce advisory comments, large deltas (resource drift that would change API behavior) can mark probe as failed.

Workspace strategy: Add `canary_workspace` feature flag—when enabled, applies first hit a canary workspace (subset of resources or customers) then promote on success. Implement promotion via Terraform Cloud run-task API.

Integrations: GitHub Actions OR GitLab CI pipelines must support Check API to surface annotations; for Terraform Cloud customers, support run-tasks and Sentinel-compatible outputs in addition to Conftest.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): implement pipeline jobs in `iac-ci-staging` branch, test against staging workspace using synthetic VPC fixtures (mocked peerings, route tables).
Phase 2 (dogfood): enable advisory policy + preflight in a single non-critical repo with low-traffic private VPC workloads; collect policy score distributions and false positives.
Phase 3 (opt-in): allow repo owners to opt-in via `.redwood/iac-pipeline.yml` (thresholds, canary flag).
Phase 4 (enforce for prod): after 3 weeks of stable metrics and low false positives, flip `block_threshold` for `production` org repos. Provide 1-week exception windows and allowlist workflow.
test_plan: Unit: Rego unit tests using Conftest; maintain >=90% rule coverage for new regos.
Integration: end-to-end run in staging running full `plan -> policy-advisor -> preflight-prober -> apply` using ephemeral credentials.
Chaos: inject drift by modifying state outside Terraform and ensure drift-gate marks the plan appropriately (advisory vs block).
Load: run policy-advisor on 50 concurrent PRs in CI to validate Conftest bundle caching and plan-json parsing performance.
risks: Regressions: new advisory mode might hide high-severity policy violations if thresholds misconfigured. Mitigation: conservative defaults and telemetry.
Latency: preflight probes could add latency to apply steps. Mitigation: limit probe set in PR, run comprehensive probes only in protected workspaces.
Permissions: Preflight-Prober needs temporary read-only creds; mis-scoped credentials could expose resources. Mitigation: least-privilege IAM templates and short-lived tokens.
False positives: rego rules may flag benign patterns; mitigation: fast feedback loop with repo owners and allowlist exceptions stored in a central `policy-exceptions` file.
notes: Owner: infra-iac team. Point person: Ravi Patel.
Related docs: Confluence doc `docs/private-deploy/iac-policy-advisor` (link in PR), RFC draft in drive: `VPC Preflight and Advisory Policy`.
Target CI tech: GitHub Actions + optional Terraform Cloud run-tasks; keep implementation modular to support GitLab later.
